Singapore_residential.scope: fatal fires in residential premises (public and private housing, and premises occupied as sleeping accommodation); all causes

England_dwellings.scope: fatal dwelling fires attended by fire and rescue services; all causes; multiple-fatality fires reconstructed from record-level fatality data; Grenfell Tower (N=71) set aside

USA_residential.scope: fatal fires in residential buildings incl. hotels, motels, dormitories; all causes; civilian deaths; shares from reporting departments

Australia_preventable_residential.scope: preventable residential fire deaths; excludes suicide and homicide with clear intent, bushfire, vehicles, supervised facilities; closed coronial cases

NewZealand_unintentional_domestic.scope: unintentional and undetermined-intent domestic fire deaths; excludes suicide, homicide, vehicles, rest homes, hostels; coronial files

Singapore_buildings.scope: fatal fires in enclosed buildings, residential and non-residential; all causes

England_all_fires_within_regime.scope: all fatal fires attended by fire and rescue services: dwellings, other buildings, road vehicles, outdoor; deliberate fires included; Shoreham (N=11, outdoor) and Grenfell Tower (N=71) set aside

China_all_fires_within_regime.scope: all recorded fires nationally (building and non-building), mainland China; three largest events (38, 74, 309 deaths) set aside

Grenfell.note: Building-only bound assigns all 141 ordinary multi-fatality fires to buildings: the heaviest building-fire severity the source admits.

residential_contrasts.SGres_vs_USA_note: USA share is a published rounded percentage (13%, admissible 12.5-13.5%); the comparison uses Singapore's exact binomial interval against that value.

contrast_sensitivities.note: The 2012-2018 and without-largest-event counts are read from the register (residential premises; the event removed is the four-death lodging-house fire, one of two four-death fires).

singapore_checks.note: Split-sample fits at observed support (Nmax = 4). The five-year split was chosen after inspecting the data; the log-linear trend test is the unbiased check.
